profitability_improvement_methods: Add per-scan live quote caching keyed by pool, direction, and amount so repeated subpaths do not consume RPC budget.
Add cheap candidate pre-ranking before live quote so the scanner quotes likely-positive cycles first.
Prefer two-hop and three-hop cycles when gross edge is similar because gas dominates small Polygon opportunities.
Keep the 5000 USD TVL floor, but expand token and venue coverage above that floor instead of weakening liquidity safety.
Use exact live quote or fork simulation for every non-V2 venue; never allow reserve approximation to create executable payloads.
Size-search per route against the final output curve, not a fixed loan amount, and stop when marginal output becomes worse than marginal gas and flash fee.
Cache external token prices and pool metadata, but refresh live quotes at execution time.
not_ready_reason: No artifact-backed route currently passes final repayment, gas, and owner profit gates.
